fields.value: Mobile and stationary air pollution measurements around an air quality monitoring site on Mäkelänkatu in Helsinki, Finland

dsDescriptionValue.value: Mobile and stationary measurements of air pollution around an air quality monitoring site on Mäkelänkatu in Helsinki, Finland. The datasets are used in evaluating high-resolution air quality simulations conducted with the PALM model system 6.0. The dataset contains: drone_data: measurements of vertical profiles of lung-deposited surface area (LDSA) conducted using a drone in summer and winter 2017 kumpula_airquality_data: airquality: basic air quality observations from the SMEAR III station dmps: aerosol size distribution observations using DMPS from the SMEAR III station met_data: kivenlahti_mast_DDMMYYYY.txt: Kivenlahti mast observations Meteorology_YYMM_10.txt: SMEAR III observations sniffer_data/long/[timeofday]YYYYMMDD.dat: horizontal distribution of air pollutants measured by the mobile laboratory Sniffer supersite_data: measurements from the air quality monitoring station on Mäkelänkatu AQdata: air quality observations DMPS: aerosol size distribution observations using DMPS ACSM: aerosol chemical composition measurements using ACSM

datasetVersion.citation: et al, 2020,  Mobile and stationary air pollution measurements around an air quality monitoring site on Mäkelänkatu in Helsinki, Finland, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.3828508
